name: Hold Back Information 4
definition: Information about hold back and gating.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of gating or a hold back.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Value of the redemption amount subject to gating or a hold back.

ExpectedReleaseDate.name: Expected Release Date
ExpectedReleaseDate.definition: Date on which the gated amount or hold back amount is expected to be released.

RedemptionCompletion.name: Redemption Completion
RedemptionCompletion.definition: Specifies whether or not additional redemption order instructions are required in order for the redemption to be completed.
